observation_indicators.observable_en: Keeps the two conditions distinct and checks local program applicability.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Pag-isahin ang dalawang sakit at magbigay ng iisang hindi nasuring mensahe.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Treat the two diseases as identical and give one unreviewed message.
